pages.text: The $(bold)Generator$() burns hemp-based fuels to produce $(bold)RF (Redstone Flux)$() energy. It is the power source for all other machines — build this first!$(br)$(br)To use: place a fuel item in the input slot. The generator will burn it and fill its internal energy buffer. Connect other machines adjacent to it or with pipes to distribute power.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Fuel values:$()$(br)• Hemp Coal: 1,600 RF$(br)• Weed (any ground weed): 3,200 RF$(br)• Weed Buds (any strain bud): 6,400 RF$(br)• Hemp Oil Bucket: 48,000 RF (bucket consumed)

pages.title: Hemp Coal
pages.text: 1,600 RF. Craft from 1 Coal + 2 Hemp Leaf. An early-game fuel option.

pages.title: Hemp Oil Bucket
pages.text: 48,000 RF per bucket — the most efficient fuel. Requires the Liquifier to produce Hemp Oil.
